name: GRI Stage D promotion contract

gates.name: PARENT_PERTURBATION
gates.requirement: The independently defined parent layer changes relative to matched control/noise under the frozen representation.

gates.name: CHILD_PREDICTION
gates.requirement: The parent perturbation representation predicts later independently measured child state above generic, scrambled, and capacity-matched controls under the frozen detector family.

gates.name: TECHNICAL_CONTEXT_ATTACK
gates.requirement: D-P2 survives prespecified technical/context/composition attacks where evaluable or is explicitly narrowed to a context-sensitive state.

gates.name: RECOVERY_PERSISTENCE
gates.requirement: Perturbation withdrawal produces measurable return/persistence structure and the parent representation predicts persistence or return under the frozen endpoint/model rules.

gates.name: INDEPENDENT_TRANSFORMATION_GENERALIZATION
gates.requirement: A recovery-associated signature frozen from D1/D2 before D3/D4 outcome inspection generalizes to at least one independent experimentally ordered transformation/resistance challenge in the prespecified direction.

gates.name: INTERVENTION_SPECIFICITY
gates.requirement: The observed parent-child response cannot be reproduced equally well by generic shared-state, shuffled-carrier, capacity-matched, or prespecified alternative controls.

nonlinear_negative_rule: A negative result under the linear detector family is not promoted to NO_RELATIONSHIP because prior synthetic validation retained a nonlinear-only failure.
higher_gate_failure_rule: Failure at a higher gate narrows the Stage-D extension but cannot erase a lower gate that was independently satisfied.
claim_ceiling: No Stage-D result may establish clinical utility, a universal substrate-inheritance law, a causal malignant-transition mechanism, or biological chi without a separately frozen future protocol specifically testing that claim.
